title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken and Asparagus Skillet
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Serve with brown rice or crusty bread.
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Season the chicken with the oregano, half the salt and the pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5–6 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through (165°F). Move it to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the asparagus and cook 3–4 minutes until bright green and just tender.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the broth, the lemon juice and the remaining salt and simmer 2 minutes.
Return the chicken, toss with the lemon zest and sprinkle with the Parmesan.

title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. Kids can build their own at the table.
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 6–7 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains (165°F).
Add the garlic, ginger and water chestnuts and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the hoisin, soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil and cook 1 minute more. Take the pan off the heat and stir in most of the green onions.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with the carrot and the remaining green onions.

title: Sheet-Pan Pesto Chicken with Green Beans and Tomatoes
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 22 min · Serves 4. Halve thick breasts so they cook evenly.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the green beans and tomatoes with the oil and half the salt and spread them on the pan.
Slice thick breasts in half horizontally, season with the remaining salt and the pepper, set them on the pan and spread the pesto over the tops.
Roast 18–20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Sprinkle the mozzarella over the chicken and return the pan to the oven for 2 minutes to melt it.

title: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Serve over brown rice or cauliflower rice.
ingredients: 1.25 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken 5–6 minutes until cooked through (165°F). Move it to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the broccoli, the bell pepper and 2 tbsp of the water and stir-fry 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and the rest of the water, pour it into the pan with the chicken and cashews, and toss 1–2 minutes until glossy.

title: Southwest Chicken and Quinoa Skillet
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 28 min · Serves 4. Everything cooks in one deep skillet.
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken, onion and pepper 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the quinoa, chili powder, cumin and salt and cook 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, corn and broth, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low 18–20 minutes until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Sprinkle with the cheese, cover for 2 minutes to melt it, and top with the avocado.

title: Parmesan-Crusted Chicken with Roasted Broccoli
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 18 min · Serves 4. Thin cutlets keep it under half an hour.
ingredients: 1.25 lb thin-sliced boneless skinless chicken cutlets
1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the broccoli with 1 tbsp oil and the salt and spread it on one side of the pan.
Mix the Parmesan, panko, garlic powder and Italian seasoning. Stir the yogurt and mustard together, brush it over the chicken, then press the chicken into the crumbs.
Lay the chicken on the other side of the pan and drizzle it with the remaining oil.
Roast 15–18 minutes, until the crust is golden and the chicken reaches 165°F. Serve with the lemon wedges.

title: Blackened Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 8 min · Serves 4. Tilapia or cod both work.
instructions: Mix the chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, cumin and salt. Pat the fish dry and rub it with the spice mix.
Toss the cabbage and cilantro with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the fish 3–4 minutes per side, until it flakes easily (145°F).
Stir the juice of half the second lime into the yogurt and cut the rest into wedges.
Warm the tortillas, flake the fish into them, and top with the slaw, a spoonful of the lime yogurt and a squeeze of lime.

title: Maple-Mustard Salmon with Sweet Potatoes and Broccoli
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 24 min · Serves 4. The sweet potatoes get a head start.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and half the salt and pepper and roast them on a sheet pan for 12 minutes.
Toss the broccoli with the remaining oil, salt and pepper.
Stir the mustard, maple syrup and garlic together.
Push the sweet potatoes aside, add the broccoli and the salmon, and brush the salmon with the maple mustard.
Roast 10–12 minutes more, until the salmon flakes easily (145°F) and the sweet potatoes are tender.

title: Garlic Shrimp with Zucchini Noodles
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 8 min · Serves 4. For hungrier eaters, swap half the zucchini for whole-wheat spaghetti.
ingredients: 1.25 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink. Move them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the garlic and the red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Add the zucchini noodles and salt and toss 2–3 minutes until just tender; longer and they turn watery.
Return the shrimp, add the lemon juice and parsley, and top with the Parmesan.

title: One-Pan Cod with Tomatoes and Olives
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 18 min · Serves 4. Serve with crusty bread or couscous.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion 4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomatoes, olives, capers and oregano and simmer 3 minutes.
Season the cod with the salt and pepper and nestle it into the sauce.
Cover and simmer 8–10 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (145°F). Scatter the basil over the top.

title: Tuna and White Bean Salad
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 0 min · Serves 4. No cooking; good for lunches.
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz each) tuna in water, drained
1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the beans, tomatoes, cucumber and onion and toss.
Fold in the tuna in large flakes and serve over the arugula.

title: Turkey Taco Skillet
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 18 min · Serves 4. Extra vegetables hide in the meat.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the turkey and onion 6–7 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains (165°F).
Add the zucchini, bell pepper and spices and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in the beans and salsa and simmer 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with the cheese, cover until it melts, and serve with warm tortillas.

title: Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowls
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Use leftover rice to make it even faster.
instructions: Cook the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat 6–7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned (160°F); drain any fat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil and simmer 2 minutes.
In a second pan, wilt the spinach 1–2 minutes with a splash of water.
Spoon the rice into bowls and top with the beef, spinach, carrots, green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Carrots
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 25 min · Serves 4. Rest the pork 5 minutes before slicing.
ingredients: 1 small red onion, cut into wedges
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the carrots and onion with 1 tbsp oil, the honey and half the salt and spread them on a sheet pan.
Rub the pork with the remaining oil, the garlic, thyme, rosemary, the remaining salt and the pepper, and set it in the middle of the pan.
Roast 20–25 minutes, until the pork reaches 145°F in the thickest part.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, then slice it and serve with the vegetables.

title: Turkey Sausage, Pepper and Potato Sheet Pan
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 27 min · Serves 4. Precooked sausage only needs browning.
ingredients: 1 lb fully cooked turkey or chicken sausage, sliced
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and half the paprika, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and roast them on a sheet pan for 12 minutes.
Toss the peppers, onion and sausage with the remaining oil and seasonings.
Add them to the pan, stir, and roast 12–15 minutes more until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is browned.

title: Pork Fried Cauliflower Rice
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Frozen riced cauliflower saves the chopping.
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into small cubes
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook the pork 4–5 minutes until browned and cooked through (145°F). Move it to a plate.
Scramble the eggs in the pan and add them to the plate.
Add the remaining oil, the cauliflower rice and the peas and carrots and stir-fry 5 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then return the pork and eggs, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions, and toss.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Serve with brown rice or warm naan.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and cumin and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and salt and simmer 10–12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and finish with the lime juice.

title: Black Bean Burgers
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. Freeze extra uncooked patties between sheets of parchment.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) black beans, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some chunky.
Pulse the oats into a coarse flour, or crush them by hand, and stir them into the beans with the egg, corn, onion and spices.
Shape into 4 patties about 3/4 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the patties 4–5 minutes per side until crisp and hot through (160°F, because of the egg).
Serve on the buns with the toppings.

title: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 30 min · Serves 6. Keeps for 4 days and freezes well.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and thyme and cook 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth and salt, bring to a boil, and simmer 18–20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the kale for 3 minutes and finish with the lemon juice.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad with Chickpeas
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Even better the next day; pack it for lunches.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Bring the quinoa and water to a boil, cover and simmer 15 minutes, then spread it on a plate to cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano and salt in a large bowl.
Add the quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, feta and parsley and toss.

title: Peanut Noodles with Edamame
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Good warm or cold.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to the package, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes. Save 1/2 cup of the cooking water, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, ginger and garlic with enough of the cooking water to make a pourable sauce.
Toss the noodles and edamame with the sauce, bell pepper and carrot.
Top with the green onions and peanuts.

title: Shakshuka
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Serve with warm whole-wheat pita.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and salt and simmer 5 minutes to thicken.
Make 6 wells in the sauce, crack an egg into each, cover, and cook 6–8 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter the feta and parsley over the top.

title: Mushroom and Spinach Whole-Wheat Penne
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Ricotta and pasta water make the sauce.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package, save 1 cup of the cooking water, and drain.
Meanwhile heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms 6–7 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the spinach until it wilts.
Toss in the pasta, ricotta, Parmesan, lemon zest, salt and pepper with enough cooking water to make it creamy.

title: Berry Overnight Oats
note: Prep 5 min · Cook 0 min · Serves 4. Make them the night before; they keep 3 days in the fridge.
ingredients: 2 cups milk or unsweetened almond milk
instructions: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup and vanilla together.
Divide among 4 jars, top with the berries, cover, and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
Eat cold, or warm for 1 minute in the microwave.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. A blender batter with no flour.
ingredients: Toppings: berries, Greek yogurt, a drizzle of maple syrup
instructions: Blend everything except the butter and toppings until smooth, and let it rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and brush it with a little butter.
Pour 1/4-cup portions and cook 2–3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.
Serve with the toppings.
